findings.message: The rev-15 review node found a BLOCKING leak introduced by the previous commit's double-render fix: the withheld-attempt notice interpolated the raw argv element, so command text (and a credential) reached the operator channel; plus a major (displayProgram's scheme-less branch rendered the last path segment verbatim, so `./alice:hunter2@host` rendered the credential) and a nit (hostToContainer still hand-rolled the prefix math). All three fixed: the notice renders through displayProgram, the scheme-less branch looks for userinfo in the whole token, and the last private segment site delegates to the shared predicate.
